question: A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only one person is sitting between C and R. Only one person is sitting to the left of C. Only two people are sitting to the right of F. R is sitting to the immediate left of F. How many people are sitting in the row?
solution: Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north. 1) Only one person is sitting to the left of C. 2) Only one person is sitting between C and R.
